title: Paul McCartney live: Denny Sanford Premier Center, Sioux Falls | 2016
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Denny Sanford Premier Center in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA, on 2 May 2016.

It was the seventh show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017. This concert was seen by 10,746 fans.

Playing it cool in Sioux Falls #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/UGGlWLEy3W

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) May 3, 2016

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Simon Says Hug My Mom #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/KQIcd0HYjo

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) May 3, 2016
